facts.value: Transcripts from every college and university from which you earned a bachelor’s degree or higher must be sent to ASU. Official transcripts must be sent directly to ASU Admission Services from the issuing institution's records office either by mail or through a secured electronic transcript service. If you attended ASU, you do not need to request ASU transcripts to be sent.

ASU accepts unofficial transcripts as part of the application. Emailed transcripts are not acceptable. If you submit unofficial transcripts and are admitted to the university, you will be required to send official transcripts to the university.

Depending on your graduate program, support materials may include a statement of purpose or writing sample, portfolio, curriculum vitae or biographical sketch or resume. Many support materials may be uploaded as part of the online application for admission.
Depending on your graduate program, letters of recommendation may also be requested.
International students must submit proof of English proficiency.
If you are residing in the U.S. on a valid visa, you will need to provide proof of your current visa.
Arizona State University, Graduate Admission Services, PO Box 871004, Tempe, AZ 85287-1004
